record.what_it_does: Gladly is a customer service/helpdesk platform (voice, email, chat, SMS, social) built around a unified customer timeline, with a REST API and webhooks for integrating customer, task, and conversation data.
record.auth_notes: Gladly uses token-based HTTP Basic Authentication: the username is the API user's agent email and the password is a generated API token, sent via the Authorization header. There is no OAuth2 flow for third-party/multi-tenant access — each customer org must create its own API token tied to an internal agent user with the 'API User' permission.
record.access_notes: Gladly has no self-serve signup or free tier; the marketing site's only CTA is 'Book a demo', and third-party pricing trackers confirm pricing/access is sales-led with a custom quote. To use the API at all you must already be a paying Gladly customer org; within that org, a Gladly Administrator must grant an agent the 'API User' permission before that agent can generate API tokens. Gladly does provide a free sandbox environment (https://{organization}.gladly.qa) for existing customers to test without touching production.
record.main_blocker: No self-serve access — becoming a Gladly customer requires a sales demo/contract, and API tokens additionally require an org Administrator to grant per-agent 'API User' permission.

evidence.quote: Gladly API uses token-based Basic Authentication. API tokens are associated with designated Gladly users.

Connect once. Use everywhere.

API and tools to get up and running in days.

Book a demo
To allow a user to create API tokens and access the API: ... Gladly Administrators can set API permissions on an agent-by-agent basis.
Clients can access the REST API via HTTPS at your organization's Gladly domain (e.g. `https://{organization}.gladly.com`).
A Webhook is a way to send notifications about Gladly events as a POST request to the endpoint of your choice.
